svg.title: One repository index on one DGX Spark
svg.desc: A repository at a verified commit is compiled once into independent BM25, dense, source and graph views, which are incremental and capability-bearing. One verified manifest publishes them as a Wiki for people, Ask through Qwen, and MCP for agents, with exact paths, line ranges and commit identity. The stack runs on loopback on an NVIDIA DGX Spark, GB10, Arm64, 128 GB unified memory, with Qwen3.6 on vLLM at port 8080. Generation and embeddings can stay local; BM25 and CodeGraph remain model-free.
svg.text: Source-linked Wiki · hybrid retrieval · CodeGraph · MCP
Exact paths · line ranges · commit identity
Generation and embeddings can stay local. BM25 and CodeGraph remain model-free.
Index once. Explore it as a Wiki. Serve it to any coding agent.
